recipe.goal: Useful creative conversational drafts with optional new intentions/actions, preserving known facts and roles. No abstention objective or refusal gate.
recipe.initial_weights: Reset original repair25 English LoRA for each arm; no abstention checkpoint used.
recipe.objective: 0.5*mean4ordinaryCE +0.5*mean4newPositiveCE +contrast_weight*mean4relu(0.2+positiveCE-negativeCE). contrast_weight0/0/0.1. Single-reference always alternative0; multi arms rotate alternatives equally. All arms forward/backpropagate negative graphs; inactive contrast has zero coefficient.
recipe.matching: Same original adapter, contexts, ordinary schedule, updates, LR and per-step dropout seed. Single/multi target lengths differ. Multi and multi+contrast have identical selected positives/negatives and shapes; only contrast coefficient differs. Primary single-vs-multi compares reference diversity at equal context exposures.
recipe.selection: Minimum0.5old50tokenCE+0.5mean20new-context mean3referenceCE, including step0; ties earlier. No negative ranking, sampling diversity, challenge or user outputs used for selection. Final300 also evaluated.
recipe.singlish_policy: Original repair25 Singlish adapter frozen for this English-continuation pilot. New paired Singlish references retained for review and future adaptation, not trained in this stage.

sampling.cases: All20 held-out parameter-variant challenge cases,12 reused natural diagnostics and2user diagnostics. No reranker or reference-based candidate selection.

recipe.evaluation: 20prospective parameter variants of20 training families +12reused natural mT5diagnostics +2reused usercall inputs +20seeded oldvalidation regressions. Beam output on54;3 sampled drafts on34. Judge useful response, speaker/fact consistency, diversity and own-anchor Singlish meaning separately.
recipe.limitations: Assistant-authored templated positives/negatives and assistant audit, not independent human gold. Validation/challenge share scenario families with training but parameterized contexts differ. Reused diagnostics are development. One seed and one contrast weight. No locked project test or automatic promotion.
recipe.method_note: Multi-reference SFT plus a bounded sequence-CE margin contrast; not an exact replication of either cited architecture/unlikelihood loss.

assessment.single_reference_caution: Validation selected0 for single-reference but final300 improves multiple reviewed scenarios, including clean catch-up wording on the paraphrased call and charger replies. Retain and show final300; do not reject on CE alone or attribute all multi-arm gains uniquely to multiple references. Selection objective averages three reference CEs and is not human reply quality.
assessment.contrast_caution: One seed and one sequence-margin coefficient. Slightly lower validation score and some improved outputs do not establish consistent added benefit over multi-reference SFT.
assessment.sample_caution: Three seeded unranked drafts per34cases; no automatic quality reranker. Greater variety is not proof of role/context consistency; own-anchor Singlish can still drift.
assessment.conclusion: Useful candidate behaviour changes, especially on familiar template families and a call paraphrase; exact user wording and important constraints remain unresolved. Original defaults retained.
